not_modeled.quote: The following bariatric surgery procedures are non-covered for all Medicare beneficiaries: Open adjustable gastric banding; Open sleeve gastrectomy; Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy (prior to June 27, 2012); Open and laparoscopic vertical banded gastroplasty; Intestinal bypass surgery; and, Gastric balloon for treatment of obesity.
